rows.definition: Gross merchandise volume: total dollar amount of all transactions on the Affirm platform during the period, net of refunds.

rows.curator_notes: Key operating metrics table: 'Gross merchandise volume (GMV) | $ 50.2' (in billions).

rows.definition: Merchant network revenue: primarily merchant fees charged on GMV processed through the platform, net of loss on loan originations and merchant incentives.
rows.caveat: Fees merchants pay Affirm. This is the merchant side of Affirm's revenue. Audited FY2026 figure in USD, July 2025 - June 2026. Dividing by GMV gives the per-$100 line; periods differ from calendar-year peers.

rows.definition: Card network revenue: interchange earned on transactions processed through Affirm's card-issuing partners (Affirm Card and virtual cards).

rows.fiscal_note: Affirm's fiscal year ends June 30; FY2026 is July 2025 - June 2026.

rows.definition: Funding costs: interest expense and fee amortization on warehouse facilities, consolidated securitizations, repurchase agreements and other loan funding.
rows.caveat: Cost of the debt that funds the loan book; one of the four transaction-cost lines. Audited FY2026 figure in USD, July 2025 - June 2026. Dividing by GMV gives the per-$100 line; periods differ from calendar-year peers.
rows.curator_notes: Statements of operations: 'Funding costs | 454,016'.
rows.source_name: Affirm Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026

rows.definition: Processing and servicing: payment processing fees, third-party customer support and collection, customer-care personnel costs, platform fees and allocated overhead.
rows.caveat: Processing and servicing cost; one of the four transaction-cost lines. Includes some personnel and overhead, not only third-party processing. Audited FY2026 figure in USD, July 2025 - June 2026. Dividing by GMV gives the per-$100 line; periods differ from calendar-year peers.
rows.curator_notes: Statements of operations: 'Processing and servicing | 613,587'.
rows.source_name: Affirm Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026

rows.definition: Merchant network revenue as a percentage of GMV, as stated by Affirm in MD&A.
rows.caveat: Affirm's own ratio of merchant fees to GMV for FY2026, rounded to 0.1 point. It shows what merchants pay per $100 of BNPL purchases before credit income.
rows.curator_notes: MD&A: 'Merchant network revenue as a percentage of GMV decreased to 2.3% for the year ended June 30, 2026 from 2.4% for the year ended June 30, 2025.'

rows.definition: Total payment volume, BILL Spend and Expense (excludes FI Channel), three months ended June 30, 2026.
rows.caveat: Card spend on BILL Spend and Expense cards in the quarter, stated to $0.1 billion. Excludes cards referred through financial-institution partners.
rows.curator_notes: Supplemental table 'Total Payment Volume (TPV, in billions)', row 'BILL Spend and Expense', column June 30, 2026: '7.1'.
rows.source_name: BILL Holdings Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results

rows.definition: Transaction fees from BILL Spend and Expense (excludes FI Channel), three months ended June 30, 2026; consists mainly of card interchange.
rows.caveat: Gross revenue from BILL's spend-management cards for the quarter, before deducting rewards. BILL does not split interchange from other card fees in this table.
rows.curator_notes: Transaction fees table, row 'BILL Spend and Expense', column June 30, 2026: '184.6' ($ millions).
rows.source_name: BILL Holdings Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
rows.fiscal_note: BILL's fiscal year ends June 30; FY2026-Q4 is April-June 2026.

rows.definition: Rewards expense (supplemental information), three months ended June 30, 2026; recorded in sales and marketing until the change in presentation from the quarter ending September 30, 2026.
rows.caveat: Cash-back and rewards BILL paid to card customers in the quarter. From the quarter ending September 30, 2026 BILL nets this against revenue, so later quarters will not show a gross figure the same way.
rows.curator_notes: Supplemental Information: 'Rewards expense | $ | 94.0' for three months ended June 30, 2026.
rows.source_name: BILL Holdings Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
rows.fiscal_note: BILL's fiscal year ends June 30; FY2026-Q4 is April-June 2026.

rows.definition: Rewards expense as a percentage of revenue from BILL Spend and Expense interchange fees, as stated by BILL.
rows.caveat: BILL's own ratio: rewards paid back to customers were 51% of Spend and Expense interchange revenue in the quarter (rounded to a whole percent).
rows.curator_notes: Supplemental Information: 'Rewards expense as a percentage of revenue from BILL Spend and Expense interchange fees | 51 %' for June 30, 2026 column.
rows.source_name: BILL Holdings Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
rows.fiscal_note: BILL's fiscal year ends June 30; FY2026-Q4 is April-June 2026.

rows.definition: Computed: BILL Spend and Expense transaction fees / Spend and Expense TPV x 100 = 184.6 / 7,100 x 100.
rows.caveat: Computed from BILL's stated quarterly figures: about $2.60 of card revenue per $100 of card spend, before rewards. TPV is rounded to $0.1 billion, so the ratio carries roughly +/-0.02.
rows.curator_notes: C from V inputs spend_expense_transaction_fees and spend_expense_tpv. Earnings-call take rate of 261 bps seen only in transcripts (search extract).
rows.source_name: BILL Holdings Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
rows.fiscal_note: BILL's fiscal year ends June 30; FY2026-Q4 is April-June 2026.

rows.definition: Computed: rewards expense / Spend and Expense TPV x 100 = 94.0 / 7,100 x 100.
rows.caveat: Computed: about $1.32 per $100 of card spend went back to customers as rewards in the quarter. TPV rounding applies.
rows.curator_notes: C from V inputs rewards_expense and spend_expense_tpv. Call-stated reward rate 133 bps seen only in transcripts.
rows.source_name: BILL Holdings Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
rows.fiscal_note: BILL's fiscal year ends June 30; FY2026-Q4 is April-June 2026.

rows.definition: Computed: (Spend and Expense transaction fees - rewards expense) / Spend and Expense TPV x 100 = (184.6 - 94.0) / 7,100 x 100.
rows.caveat: Computed: about $1.28 per $100 of card spend left after rewards, before credit losses, processing and funding costs. This is the reading registered question Q4 tests (1.0-1.6% band).
rows.curator_notes: C from V inputs. 90.6/7100 = 1.276%.
rows.source_name: BILL Holdings Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
rows.fiscal_note: BILL's fiscal year ends June 30; FY2026-Q4 is April-June 2026.

rows.curator_notes: Table 7 'Cost KPIs, at global level': 'KPI 1: Average cost of B2B (MSME) cross-border payment transactions | 1.6% (0 pp) | 1.6% (+0.1 pp) | 1.5%'. Source note 'Data as of March 2025'.

gaps.metric: Network assessment and processing fees (the card-network layer of the per-$100 acquiring waterfall)
gaps.why: Visa's public interchange schedule lists only issuer interchange; Visa's US network assessment fees are not published on the sheet, so the network layer stays an undisclosed interval.

gaps.metric: Average realised take rate and acquirer margin after interchange and network fees
gaps.why: Stripe is private and publishes only list prices; negotiated pricing for large merchants and its net revenue per $100 are not disclosed.

gaps.metric: Spend and Expense interchange revenue in dollars, and the call-stated take rate (261 bps) and reward rate (133 bps)
gaps.why: The 8-K gives Spend and Expense transaction fees and rewards as a share of interchange, not interchange itself; the bps figures were stated on the earnings call and were seen only in transcript extracts, so the per-$100 lines here are computed from the filed table instead.

gaps.metric: First quarter reported net of rewards (quarter ending 2026-09-30)
gaps.why: Not yet published; BILL's FQ1'27 results are expected in November 2026.

gaps.metric: Revenue less transaction costs (non-GAAP) for FY2026 from a primary page
gaps.why: RLTC appears in the FQ4'26 shareholder letter, whose SEC copy is image-only; it was seen only in a third-party repost. W2 can compute it from the four filed transaction-cost lines and total revenue recorded here.

gaps.metric: H1 FY2027 cross-border take rate (registered question Q7)
gaps.why: Not yet published; H1 FY27 results are due after this check. Q1 FY27 (0.50%) is the latest figure.

gaps.metric: 2026 average cost of B2B (MSME) cross-border payments (registered question Q7)
gaps.why: The 2026 progress report with KPI results is not yet published; the FSB 2026 work programme schedules it for November 2026 (seen in a search extract). The 2025 report is the latest.
